headline: Integration progress, NOT capability progress. The product does not have fusion. The fusion stage is default-OFF, nothing downstream reads it, and on the only full-artifact clip it correctly refused to refine all 24 contacts.

defect_a.problem: PIPELINE_SUMMARY.json declared a bundle capability named 'fusion' satisfied by the 'world' stage, which is a compositor (threed/racketsport/virtual_world.py 'assembles' finished artifacts) and performs no joint refinement.
defect_a.naming_rationale: Matches the repo's own verb for the stage (virtual_world.py 'assemble', RUNBOOK stage 19 'compose') and NORTH_STAR 1.4's habit of naming evidence for what produced it.
defect_a.compatibility_decision: outright rename, no dual-key alias, break documented
defect_a.compatibility_justification: The name reaches the outside world only via PIPELINE_SUMMARY.json -> missing_capabilities[].capability, and only when the artifact is ABSENT; a complete bundle never contained the string. No committed JSON schema enumerates capability names. A legacy alias would re-assert the false claim this change exists to correct. The worker and server were renamed in lockstep because server.bundle_policy.gate_reported_status() compares the two lists and a one-sided rename would silently downgrade every complete bundle to partial.
defect_a.mixed_version_safety: An older summary carrying {'capability': 'fusion'} is copied forward by evaluate_bundle; _append_missing is additive and de-duplicates by name, so a stale entry can only add a partial reason to a bundle that was already partial. No bundle is misclassified in either direction.

defect_b.problem: threed/racketsport/one_world_v1.py (1571 lines), the real confidence-weighted joint-refinement module, had zero pipeline call sites.
defect_b.best_stack_revision_rationale: Precedent commit 57239d8 added an R&D-only enabled=false PENDING entry and explicitly recorded 'no revision bump'. Manifest stays at revision 15; only 'updated' moved to 2026-07-24.
defect_b.preset_exclusion_rationale: court_skeletons has no ball stages at all, so it can never satisfy the required inputs; running it there would guarantee a blocked outcome on every run. Enforced twice: COURT_SKELETON_STAGE_NAMES exclusion and a forced-off in build_options_from_args.
defect_b.schema_validation_method: OneWorldV1.model_validate_json on the exact emitted bytes, before publication; a test asserts OneWorldV1.model_json_schema() == the committed schema so drift is caught.

byte_identity_when_off.mechanism: authoritative_stage_names(..., one_world=False) default plus omission of the best_stack key from resolved_best_stack_config_from_options while off

degradation_semantics.mechanism: ExpectedOptionalAbsence, the repo's existing typed-absence mechanism
degradation_semantics.why_it_matters: build_one_world hard-raises FileNotFoundError without ball_track.json, and every run in the last four days used --pipeline-preset court_skeletons which produces none; a naive wiring would have hard-failed on 100% of current runs.

identity_graph_registration.reuse_verified_empirically: ran -> skipped (reused generation) -> ran after mutating ball_track.json

end_to_end.drove: the real pipeline stage via _run_stage_safely, not the scaffold CLI
end_to_end.note: smpl_motion.json in that directory is a broken symlink, so the run exercised the real skeleton3d.json fallback path

known_bad_results_reported_not_hidden.off_court_method: court_zones.json polygon, x +/-3.048 m, y +/-6.7056 m, rectangle so bbox is exact; brief cited ~51% on a different basis
known_bad_results_reported_not_hidden.interpretation: REFUSAL IS CORRECT BEHAVIOUR. With ball 3D that far off-court no player wrist is within the 1.2 m co-location radius, so the co-location likelihood loses to the null hypothesis and the refiner abstains instead of inventing a hitter.

other_real_numbers.honest_reading: The fusion changed essentially nothing and abstained from every contact. Sixth-significant-figure movement in player reprojection is noise, not improvement, and is not evidence of anything.

blast_radius_suite.note: identical command both sides; the branch run additionally includes the two new test files, which do not exist at base

NORTH_STAR_ROADMAP.md is 528 lines against a <=500 assertion

wide_suite.time_box_rationale: The full tests/ tree is single-threaded (pytest-xdist not installed) and slow on this CPU; the source lane oneworld_impl_20260716 time-boxed its own wide run at 1002s for the same reason. Both sides were interrupted at the same symmetric progress point (~33%).
wide_suite.caveat: Both runs used clean git-archive extracts of their respective commits, which lack untracked data/ and runs/ fixture files that many tests need. That inflates the absolute failure count on BOTH sides equally, so the comparison is valid but the absolute 54 is not a statement about repo health.

audit_storage_policy.attribution: pre-existing f9dc11d registry drift, identical to the blast-radius storage failure; unchanged by this branch

incident.what: While interrupting my own two time-boxed wide runs, my process-matching pattern ('pytest tests/') was too broad and also sent SIGINT to a concurrent agent's test run in /Users/arnavchokshi/Desktop/pickleball/.claude/worktrees/ball-lane-20260723.
incident.impact: That lane's full suite was killed at 43:05 having reached 71 failed, 3937 passed, 30 skipped, 28 errors. Its partial log survives at scratchpad/postrebase_full.log but no exit file was written, so it will need to re-run to get a clean exit code.
incident.damage: No file was modified, no repo state was corrupted, and the main checkout was never written to. The cost is that lane's wall-clock time.
incident.disclosure: Reported rather than hidden. The ball-lane-20260723 owner should be told to re-run.
